categories.parameter binding: Exact argument slot one enters its resolved target and selected call context.
categories.caller argument binding: A formal sink expands to its caller argument slot one without an initially selected callee frame; exact resolved target identity is checked.
categories.parameter use: The parameter supplies a value use in the same method.
categories.storage write: The actual setter assignment uses the RHS in argument slot two; field declaration code is not the stored value.
categories.exceptional memory effect exit: Stored state crosses a failed call or resumed thrown exit; this is not an exception payload or scalar return dependency.
categories.resolved call exit: The method identity matches the resolved caller target; void setters/helpers carry memory effects, getters/read return scalar values.
categories.storage continuation: Invisible entry evidence resumes CFG storage traversal at the selected caller; completed unrelated-slot cleanup does not kill the requested slot.
categories.method exit evidence: Return/normal completion carries stored state or the scalar getter/helper value.
categories.returned value: The getter/read value supplies its explicit return operand.
categories.assignment or use: Source/evaluation temporary storage supplies a later use without reevaluation.
categories.saved scalar result: The resolved getter/helper return supplies a saved RHS or caught-result temporary.

limitations: DART-FLOW-007 original static field copy is corrected. copiedBothNormal and copiedBothCaught share the same source and invocation; only the caught return retains input. helperCopyCaught preserves a saved getter value through identity and an intervening other-slot write.

Negative controls share exact source endpoints and budgets; forwarding controls prove available callee inputs. All negative absence remains inconclusive under the reported initialization/exception/external limits.

localCopyNormal is the diagnosed DART-FLOW-008 false positive. Its local saved=input occurs only before throwing, while normal cleanup requires saved to be constant. The serialized normal demand is retained but ordinary local reaching definitions do not enforce it.
localCopyCaught is the nearby runtime/graph positive control. The native oracle executes three inputs and both booleans, including repeated independent calls and saved-read overwrite isolation.

Complete returned transitions and task demands are retained; CFG predecessor histories are not complete execution traces. Bounded searches do not prove general path feasibility, initialization state or complete heap support.
